features.title: See the browser agents drive
features.summary: Agents › Browser (browse), also in the command palette and the New tab view chooser, reads `browse status --json` on the Host: CLI version, whether the relay runs, the extension and connected browsers, and the agent tabs. It never starts the relay, refreshes every pollIntervalMs while open, and says how to install browse when the CLI is missing. Agents read the same status with browse_status.
reachNarrow: click button "Agents Configured agents and their messages."
features.currentSurface: Agents › Browser (browse); command palette and New tab › Browser (browse)

onboarding.firstAction: Open Browser (browse) from the command palette to see whether the relay and your browser are connected.
onboarding.doneWhen: The panel shows the browse version and your browser as connected.

configuration.constraints: A program name looked up on PATH plus ~/.local/bin, ~/.nix-profile/bin, /etc/profiles/per-user/$USER/bin and the system profiles, or an absolute path.
1000 to 60000 milliseconds; the panel polls at most every 2 s while a pairing code waits.

failureModes: browse missing from every searched directory shows the install command (Nix or the curl installer) and the command setting to point at it.
A non-zero exit or unreadable status JSON shows the exit code and `browse status` to run in a terminal.
A stopped relay is reported as such; reading status never starts it.

features.title: Pair a browser with a one-time code
features.summary: Pair a browser runs `browse pair --wait-seconds 600` on the Host and shows its one-time code large with a copy button and where to enter it (Extensions → browse → Options). The process keeps waiting Host-side; the panel then shows paired, expired, failed or cancelled. One pairing runs at a time: starting again returns the same code, Cancel stops it. Paired browsers are listed from `browse pair --list` and can be unpaired after a confirmation. Agents get browse_pair_start, browse_pair_cancel, browse_pairings and browse_pairing_revoke (confirm: true required).
reachNarrow: click button "Agents Configured agents and their messages."
features.currentSurface: Agents › Browser (browse) › Pair a browser and Paired browsers
failureModes: browse pair exiting before it prints a code, or printing none within 20 s, fails the start with `browse pair` to run in a terminal.
A code nobody redeems within 10 minutes ends as expired, with Pair another browser for a fresh one.
Unpairing a browser that is no longer paired answers not unpaired and asks to list again.
A DSH restart drops the waiting process; the code then cannot complete and a new pairing is needed.

externalDependencies.boundary: The browse CLI pair verbs and the browser extension that redeems the code

features.title: Tabs waiting on you reach the Inbox
features.summary: When an agent's browse call waits on a person (sign-in, captcha, 2FA), each waiting tab becomes a blocking Inbox item with the agent's message, resolved once the call continues, and the panel header shows how many tabs wait. The Host reads `browse status --json` every pollIntervalMs only while notifyHandoffs is on (off by default, since it spends Host time without an agent asking); turning it off resolves the open items and stops the check. It runs the local CLI only and spends no tokens.
